d:
Minutes filed in the Supreme Court show Meta told the Home Ministry's cybercrime wing it acted on over 61,000 violent and inciting posts in the fortnight after the NEET protests. The ministry also asked Meta to explain how its algorithm amplifies content. Inside the 439-page report, the Centre retreats on the kill switch, victims get back Rs 5 for every Rs 100 lost, and junior police may soon investigate IT Act offences. Vrinda Tulsian explains.
